Attica chips and onion dip.d: Ridged potato chips with our own dip: onions cooked slow until deep brown, stirred into sour cream and cream cheese with chives.
Attica chips and onion dip.note: For a crowd. Call a day ahead.

Deli hero wedges.d: Ham, salami and provolone with shredded iceberg and ripe tomato, dressed with oil, vinegar and oregano, pressed and cut in wedges.

Hostage pizza.d: Thin crust, crushed tomato and oregano, plenty of mozzarella and coins of spicy cured sausage, baked fast in a blazing oven.
Hostage pizza.note: The one the whole block orders.

Italian ice.d: Fresh-squeezed juice and grated zest in sugar syrup, frozen and scraped by hand until fluffy. Served in paper cups.
Italian ice.note: The coldest thing on the avenue.

Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.d: Lager poured over two ice cubes and a fresh squeeze, the glass rimmed with salt, grated zest and a pinch of chili powder.
Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.note: From the ice chest. Air conditioned inside.
